resources.string:
Nika is a screen reader for Android.

What's new in this version:
• Voices by language and alphabet are now the first item of speech synthesis: voices of any installed synthesizer, own speed and volume for each language, detection by alphabet or by Unicode. Ukrainian text is no longer read in English.
• Sound feedback volume is a slider from 0 to 100; microphone on/off beeps and the translator beep are back, with a switch.
• Settings groups that fold say collapsed and expanded again; only the word heading is removed there.
• New: Protection from closing, and Nika voice commands (several recognition engines).
